calls.title: Growthbook <> Stage - Pricing Discussion
calls.summary: We need to summarize the transcript in 2-3 sentences, focusing on product/features/pain points, key participants and roles, and next steps. The call is between Daniel Wathne (GrowthBook) and Ashish Pandey (Stage). They discuss pricing: GrowthBook offers a fixed-rate pricing model vs Statsig's usage-based model. Ashish's pain points: coming off Statsig startup program, want self-hosted, only need basic A/B testing and feature flagging, not deep analysis. Daniel proposes $24k/year for 10 users (discounted from Statsig's $10k quote? Actually Statsig quoted $10k? Wait: Daniel says Statsig quoted about $10k, but GrowthBook is $24k but with discount from original. Daniel says short-term more expensive but long-term better). Ashish needs to discuss with CTO and other founders, will get back by end of day. Also, they may set up a demo with Graham. Next steps: Daniel to send formal proposal and documentation; potential demo Wednesday morning (Ashish's time). So summary: Daniel Wathne (GrowthBook) presented a $24k/year fixed-rate enterprise license (self-hosted or cloud) to Ashish Pandey (Stage), contrasting with Statsig's usage-based pricing to address Ashish's pain points of cost predictability and basic A/B testing/feature flagging needs. Ashish will discuss with his CTO and other founders by end
